key.description: theme/kind/tier the new entry is written under

description.description: what the surface is, in plain words; the template turns it into the full prompt

brandName.description: business the advertisement is for; never enters the diffusion prompt, it is stroked into the emission map afterwards, so the named world can rebrand a screen without a new render

businessKind.description: what that business sells, in plain words (noodle bar, pawn shop, parfumery); this one does steer the artwork

physical.$comment: same shape as material-entry physical; authored, not estimated

finish.description: how a photographed surface is read into relief and gloss; ignored by the pattern, recolor and screen lanes, and inherited from the entry when appending

roughness.description: [min, max] band the roughness map stays inside; default: the roughness factor plus or minus 0.05

grain.description: how much of the pixel-scale speckle survives into the relief; 0 keeps feature scale alone

relief.description: gain on the feature-scale relief: joints, bricks, aggregate

flatColor.description: when set, the basecolor is synthesized procedurally from this color (glass, plain colors) instead of generated via ComfyUI

pattern.description: procedural lane: the surface is drawn from these parameters instead of photographed, crisp and tileable by construction

colors.description: face color first, then the band color and the trim color for the kinds that take them

cells.description: cells across one tile; for hexagon, columns and staggered row pairs (x about 1.73 times y keeps them regular)

line.description: joint or edge line width, in metres

bevel.description: chamfer width beside a joint, in metres

depth.description: relief between a face and a joint

joint.description: how much darker and rougher a joint reads

variation.description: tone spread from one cell to the next

sheen.description: gloss spread from one cell to the next: a printed pattern

octaves.description: octaves of a noise field: one is a plain wall, four is asphalt

wet.description: puddle only: how much of the surface stands under water; 0 is a dry road, 0.5 floods about half of it

bond.description: running shifts every other row half a cell; needs an even row count

axis.description: which way stripe bands and the two-tone split run

split.description: where the band boundary sits, as a fraction of the tile

recolor.description: tint lane: another variant of the entry this one is appended to, repainted

from.description: the variant id the tint is made from

color.description: the paint: its hue is taken whole

strength.description: how much pigment is in the paint

emission.description: how the emission map is made: derived from the base color, or `image` for a screen, where ComfyUI paints the artwork straight into the emission map and flatColor becomes the dark display glass

screens.description: screen lane only: one display per variant, in order; its length sets the variant count

kind.description: led-dot and scanline-billboard show photographic ad artwork through their pixel structure; glyph-panel is an abstract glowing panel

description.description: the advertisement itself, as flat brandless artwork; what the source shows when imagePath is set

imagePath.description: a provided source image, relative to the box folder, used as the artwork instead of diffusing one; it goes through a ComfyUI 4x upscale and then the same screen treatment

brandName.description: overrides the request brandName for this screen

businessKind.description: overrides the request businessKind for this screen

pitch.description: pixels per LED cell or scan band; default: width/160

variantId.description: id and asset folder for the variant; default: its position in the entry

append.description: add the variant to the existing entry, which keeps its alignment, tiling and physical, instead of writing a new entry
